banner.title: changedetection
banner.tagline: Watches web pages for changes, renders them in a Chrome sidecar, and keeps each watch history on a backed-up claim.

art.about: a page watcher that renders a web page in headless Chrome and diffs it against the last copy
art.title: How changedetection watches a page

explainer.title: Render the page, diff it, keep the history

steps.title: Fetch
steps.text: The app container runs changedetection.io and checks each watched URL on its schedule. JavaScript pages go to the browser sidecar.
steps.scene: a web page card under a magnifying eye

steps.title: Render
steps.text: The browserless container listens on localhost port 3000 and runs Chrome with ads blocked and stealth on. It runs as its own uid.
steps.scene: a headless browser window with a shield

steps.title: Diff
steps.text: Each check is stored under /datastore. The diff compares it with the previous snapshot of the same watch.
steps.scene: two stacked page snapshots with one highlighted line

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: A change goes to the notification URLs set in the UI. Those URLs live in the datastore, not in Git.

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur backs up the claim changedetection-config to Ceph and R2, so the watch history survives a rebuild.
